trigger: Optional: the hot-springs den. Two Tallmen in torpor (dixie_hotsprings_den).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Steam over a cracked white basin. Bones in the shallows: sheep, mostly. At the edge of the water, two shapes, curled.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: They're asleep. Breathing slow. Long hands folded under long heads. They look almost peaceful.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: Please. They're asleep. They're animals. We made them. Please don't do this.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Every one that wakes this winter will come for the warmth. Your warmth. You don't know how many there are.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: It's quick. It's not clean. Wraith won't come near you for an hour afterward.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: ...Okay. Okay. That's two fewer. I hope it's enough. I hope you never find out if it was.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You leave them sleeping in the steam. Wraith walks fast and doesn't look back.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: Thank you. I know what it might cost. I'm sorry that it might.
